title: OSPF Version 2
publisher_or_issuer: IETF OSPF Working Group / RFC Editor

provenance.original_holder: IETF OSPF Working Group publication stream

claims_extracted.claim: OSPF is an IGP based on link-state/SPF technology, explicitly described as a departure from the Bellman-Ford base of traditional TCP/IP routing protocols.
RFC 1583 is an OSPF Version 2 revision that obsoletes RFC 1247.

notes: Strong primary evidence for treating OSPF as a different algorithmic family from RIP rather than RIP's formal revision descendant.
